raw.rationale: The compound is a launched anti-herpes DNA polymerase inhibitor (likely acyclovir/valacyclovir-like) with negligible activity against human cancer cell lines at 2.5 µM because it requires viral thymidine kinase for activation and has poor cellular uptake/phosphorylation in tumour cells; PRISM screens of such antivirals show no lineage-selective killing. Thus selective lineage probabilities are near the low end of the base rate, with no lineage expected to meet the -0.5 mean log2FC threshold.
